summary: Pipeline — ordered stack of StreamTransform instances. Transforms listed outermost-first (matching stored byte order). apply_read() strips layers outer→inner; apply_write() wraps layers inner→outer (reversed). The same Pipeline instance is used on both paths — the facade applies direction automatically. An empty Pipeline() is a no-op pass-through.
lifecycle_notes: Pipeline(Gzip(), GPG(...)) means outer=Gzip, inner=GPG — on-disk bytes are gzip-wrapped gpg ciphertext
The naming convention 'outermost-first' is critical for users composing multi-layer pipelines
documentation_hooks: The ordering semantics (outermost-first = read order) must be clearly documented — this is the most common user mistake
examples: CLAUDE.md Pipeline usage in copy_between with source_pipeline=/destination_pipeline=
risks: Incorrect transform ordering silently produces wrong output — no validation at construction time
